component.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh
component.description: DeepSeek Harness runtime embedded in the TaskHive Electron app (slot payload).

properties.name: taskhive:sbom.discovery.rule
properties.value: A component is a directory that sits inside a node_modules directory (top level, the .pnpm virtual store, or a real nested node_modules) and contains a parseable package.json with name and version. Symlinks/junctions are read through but never traversed. package.json manifests that are not inside any node_modules directory (for example nan/tools/package.json and fast-uri/benchmark/package.json in this payload) are fixtures, not installed packages, and are deliberately not components.

properties.name: taskhive:sbom.serialNumber.derivation
properties.value: urn:uuid derived from the slot closure sha256 (deterministic)
